# Test fixtures

Real game files used as test input (logs, `profile.sii`, `manifest.sii`, crash dumps).

**This repository is public. Before adding a fixture:**

- Remove or replace personal data: profile names, profile IDs (they are the hex-encoded
  profile name!), Windows/macOS user names in paths, Steam IDs, e-mail addresses.
- Never add mod archives (`.scs`, `.zip`) — they belong to their authors.
- Prefer small, hand-made files that only contain what a test needs.
